snippet.title: Scottside — Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Scottside is a nonlinear visual novel in the thriller genre. A small provincial town may seem like a pretty dull place… until everything changes when you discover a strange object in the forest.

A newcomer arrives in a seemingly peaceful town, only to find that the situation has worsened, with children going missing and creepy circuses appearing. The visual narrative hints at a dark mystery and disturbing secrets beneath the town's calm exterior, creating truly scary cases. This video explores the dark mysteries and horror stories within this seemingly quiet place, promising some scary stories.
